summary: Rotate Splunk HEC token for beta customer audit export (Acme Banking) and verify exporter resumes
description:
Request
- Customer (beta): Acme Banking
- Ask: Rotate Splunk HEC token used for Redwood SIEM-ready audit export (Splunk destination) after customer-side security policy flagged the token as needing rotation.
- Constraint: No downtime expectation, but at-least-once delivery semantics mean we may see duplicates during retry/replay; customer can dedup on event_id.

Impact
- If not rotated: exporter will continue failing with 401/403 to Splunk HEC, leading to growing export lag and potential alerting.
- Current state at time of intake: intermittent auth failures reported by customer SOC; exporter shows elevated adapter_error_rate for destination splunk-hec (acme).

Scope
- Rotate token securely (no token in Jira/Slack), update secret reference for destination config, verify exporter resumes sending, verify lag drains.

References
- Splunk HEC internal setup guide: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/integration-guides/splunk-hec-audit-export-integration-internal-guide.json
- On-call runbook for delivery failures: sources/confluence/eng-sre/runbooks/runbook-audit-exporter-delivery-failures.json

Operational plan (approved)
1) Coordinate maintenance window with customer (15 min). Customer generates new Splunk HEC token for the same index/sourcetype.
2) Pause export for the Splunk destination (control plane toggle) to avoid flapping during changeover.
3) Store new token in secrets manager via standard workflow (no plaintext token in tickets).
4) Update destination config to point to new secret version / reference.
5) Resume export.
6) Validate:
   - Control plane status endpoint shows last_success advances.
   - Exporter metrics: splunk_adapter_send_success_total increasing, splunk_adapter_auth_error_total stops increasing.
   - Export lag decreases and returns under SLO threshold.
   - Spot-check in Splunk that events are landing with expected metadata and include event_id.

Acceptance criteria
- Splunk destination shows Healthy in Console for Acme tenant.
- Export lag for Acme tenant < 5 minutes sustained for 30 minutes.
- No auth errors for 30 minutes post-rotation.

Security notes
- Token must not be pasted into Jira comments.
- Any screenshots shared must redact hostnames/index names if customer requests (Acme policy).
- Confirm exporter logs do not print token (expected behavior; adapter should redact).

resolution: Splunk HEC token rotated successfully for Acme Banking. Destination export was paused briefly, secret reference updated, export resumed, and health verified via exporter metrics and control-plane status. Export lag returned under SLO and auth errors stopped.
follow_ups: Optional product/docs follow-up: add customer-facing note in Console on expected dedup behavior during credential rotation (at-least-once semantics).
Verify next weekly beta check-in includes a quick validation of Splunk indexing/search saved query for event_id sampling.
